name: Noah Shop Builder for WooCommerce – Gutenberg Woo Builder, Woo Blocks & Woo Store Templates
author: WP Shark

sections.description:
Noah Shop Builder for WooCommerce is a comprehensive WooCommerce page builder designed specifically for the WordPress Gutenberg editor. Build beautiful, conversion-optimized online stores without writing a single line of code.

Noah is a Gutenberg Woo builder and Woo shop builder in one plugin. Use Woo blocks to design every page of your Woo store – single product, shop, product archive, cart, empty cart, checkout, thank-you and My Account – right inside the block editor. No Elementor or other page builder needed: it is a native Gutenberg WooCommerce builder with 50 WooCommerce blocks, starter templates and built-in Quick View, Wishlist and Variation Swatches modules.

Why Choose Noah Woo Builder?

  • Gutenberg WooCommerce Builder – Build your whole Woo store with the WordPress block editor you already know.
  • Woo Shop Builder – Design the shop page, category pages and product archives with sortable product grids and lists.
  • Woo Product Page Builder – Build custom single product pages with gallery, price, add to cart, tabs, reviews and related products.
  • Woo Cart & Checkout Builder – Lay out the cart, empty cart and checkout pages with blocks.
  • WooCommerce Blocks for Any Page – Show newest, best selling, on sale, featured or top rated products anywhere.
  • Variation Swatches – Turn variation dropdowns into color, image or label swatches.
  • Quick View – Let shoppers open a product in a popup without leaving the shop page.
  • Wishlist – Let shoppers save products for later, as guests or logged-in customers.
  • Fast and Lightweight – Built on native blocks, with no extra page builder loaded on your store.
  • Free – All core Woo builder features are free.

Gutenberg Woo Blocks for Every Store Page

Noah gives the block editor a full set of Gutenberg Woo blocks. Product, shop, cart, checkout, thank-you and account blocks all work together, so the Woo shop builder and the block editor feel like one tool. Start a Woo store from a starter design, swap blocks in and out, and see the result with a real product while you edit.

  • Shop Builder – Shop page, category, tag and search pages from Woo blocks.
  • Product Page Builder – Single product layouts with gallery, price, add to cart and tabs.
  • Cart & Checkout Builder – Cart, empty cart and checkout pages from Woo blocks.
  • Account Builder – Thank-you and My Account pages from Woo blocks.

Key Features

  • Gutenberg-Native Blocks – Seamlessly integrates with the WordPress block editor
  • Product Display Blocks – Showcase products with customizable title, price, images, and description blocks
  • Drag & Drop Interface – Intuitive visual builder for easy customization
  • Ready-Made Templates – Pre-designed layouts to get you started quickly
  • Shop Templates – Design your single product, shop, archive, cart, empty cart, checkout, order received (thank you), my account and quick view pages, and choose where each template shows
  • Checkout Builder – Lay out the WooCommerce checkout with blocks: billing, shipping, order review, payment and more
  • Thank You and My Account pages – Build the order received page and the customer account pages from blocks
  • Modules – Quick View, Wishlist and Variation Swatches, each turned on with one switch
  • Accessible – Blocks, popups and swatches work with the keyboard and are checked against WCAG 2.2 AA
  • No Coding Required – Build professional stores without technical knowledge

Single Product Blocks

  • Product Title – Shows the product name as a heading, optionally linked to the product.
  • Product Price – Shows the product price and updates when a variation is selected.
  • Product Image – Product image gallery with WooCommerce zoom, slider and lightbox.
  • Product Excerpt – Shows the product’s short description.
  • Product Description – Shows the product’s full description.
  • Add To Cart – WooCommerce add to cart form for simple, variable, grouped and external products.
  • Product Rating – Average star rating with the review count.
  • Product Reviews – Product reviews list and the review form.
  • Product Tabs – Description, additional information, reviews and tabs added by other plugins.
  • Additional Information – Product attributes, weight and dimensions; follows the selected variation.
  • Product Meta – SKU, categories and tags as WooCommerce shows them.
  • Product SKU – Shows the product SKU; follows the selected variation.
  • Product Stock – Stock status with optional custom labels; follows the selected variation.
  • Product Categories – The product’s categories as links.
  • Product Tags – The product’s tags as links.
  • Product Share – Social share links and a copy-link button, without third-party scripts.
  • Breadcrumbs – WooCommerce breadcrumbs: Home › Shop › Category › Product.
  • Related Products – Products related to the current product by category and tag.
  • Upsells – The upsell products set on the current product.
  • Store Notices – WooCommerce messages such as “Added to cart”, coupon results and errors.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Stock Progress Bar – Shows how much of the stock has sold. For products that manage stock.
  • Deal Countdown – Time left on the product’s sale, from its sale end date.
  • Sticky Add to Cart – A bar with the product and its add to cart button that stays on screen once the shopper scrolls past the form.
  • Buy Now Button – An option on the Add To Cart block that adds the product and goes straight to checkout.
  • Size Chart – The product’s size chart from Products → Size Charts, in the page or behind a “Size guide” button in a popup.
  • Product Tabs Layouts – Accordion and stacked layouts for the Product Tabs block.

Shop & Archive Blocks

  • Archive Products – Products of the shop, category, tag or search page as a card grid or list, or WooCommerce’s own product loop.
  • Products – Newest, best selling, on sale, featured or top rated products, on any page.
  • Archive Title – Title of the shop page, or of the category, tag or search being viewed.
  • Archive Description – Description of the category or tag being viewed, or the shop page content.
  • Archive Result Count – Shows a count such as “Showing 1–12 of 40 results”.
  • Archive Pagination – Page links for product listings that keep the sorting and filters.
  • Order By Filter – Lets shoppers sort products by popularity, rating, date or price.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Product Filters – Lets shoppers narrow the products without a page reload, with product counts and a shareable URL. Holds the filter blocks below.
    • Category Filter – Pick one or more product categories.
    • Price Filter – Set a price range with a slider or by typing it.
    • Attribute Filter – Filter by an attribute such as color or size, as a list, swatches or a dropdown.
    • Rating Filter – Show only products rated at least a number of stars.
    • Stock Status Filter – Show only products in stock, on backorder or out of stock.
    • Active Filters – The filters the shopper picked, each with a remove button.
    • Reset Filters – A button that turns every filter off.
  • Products Per Page – Lets shoppers choose how many products the page shows.
  • Archive View Mode – Grid and list buttons that switch the product view without reloading.
  • Advanced Search – A product search box that lists matching products while the shopper types, with an optional category menu.
  • Product Category List – Your product categories with images and product counts, as a grid, a list or a carousel.
  • Recently Viewed – The products a shopper looked at earlier in their visit.
  • Deal Products – Products on sale with an end date, soonest first, each with a countdown.
  • Flash Sale Products – Products whose sale falls inside the campaign dates, with a countdown to the end.
  • Product Card Layouts – Overlay and flip card layouts, a carousel display for product lists and swatches on cards.

Cart Blocks

  • Cart Table – Cart items with quantities, remove links, the coupon field and the update button.
  • Cart Total – Cart totals with shipping, taxes, the shipping calculator and the checkout button.
  • Cross-Sell – Cross-sell products for the items in the cart.
  • Empty Cart Message – The “Your cart is currently empty.” message for the empty cart page.
  • Return To Shop – A button that takes shoppers back to the shop page.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Side Cart – A cart icon with the item count that opens a cart drawer: change quantities, remove items and go to checkout without leaving the page.
  • Free Shipping Bar – “Add $12 more to get free shipping!” with a progress bar, for the cart, product pages and headers.

Checkout Blocks

  • Checkout Form – The checkout form. The billing, shipping, order review and payment blocks go inside it.
  • Billing – The billing address fields, and the create account fields for guests.
  • Shipping – The “Ship to a different address?” toggle and the shipping address fields.
  • Checkout Shipping Methods – The shipping method choice, shown apart from the order review.
  • Additional – Extra order fields added by WooCommerce or by plugins such as Checkout Field Editor.
  • Order Notes – The order notes field, saved as the customer note on the order.
  • Order Review – The “Your order” table with products, shipping, taxes and total, updated as the shopper fills in the form.
  • Checkout Payment – The payment methods, terms checkbox and Place order button.
  • Checkout Coupon – The “Have a coupon?” link and coupon form.
  • Checkout Login – The “Returning customer?” link and login form for guests.

Thank You Blocks

  • Thank You Message – The thank-you message of the order received page, or the failed payment message with its Pay button.
  • Order Overview – The order number, date, email, total and payment method.
  • Order Details – The ordered items, totals and downloads, with the payment method’s instructions and the addresses.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Customer Details – The billing and shipping addresses, shown to the customer who placed the order.
  • Payment Instructions – What the payment method shows after checkout, such as bank transfer details.

My Account Blocks

  • Account Navigation – The account menu: dashboard, orders, addresses, account details and more.
  • Account Content – The account page being visited, including pages added by other plugins.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Login / Register – The login form and, when your store allows it, the registration form.
  • Account Dashboard – The welcome text and links to the other account pages.
  • Account Orders – The customer’s orders, with pagination.
  • Account Downloads – The customer’s downloadable products.
  • Account Addresses – The billing and shipping addresses and the form to edit them.
  • Account Details – The form for the customer’s name, email and password.
  • Horizontal Account Navigation – A horizontal layout for the Account Navigation block.

Modules

Turn modules on in Noah Shop Builder → Modules. Each one is off until you turn it on, and has its own settings.

  • Quick View – A “Quick view” button on product cards opens the product in an accessible popup, with gallery, variations and add to cart. Design the popup with a Quick View template.
  • Wishlist – Shoppers save products from product cards and product pages. Works for logged-in customers and guests; a guest’s list moves to their account when they log in.
    • Wishlist Button – Adds the product to the wishlist or removes it.
    • Wishlist Counter – A heart with the number of saved products, linked to the wishlist page.
    • Wishlist Table – The saved products with price, stock, add to cart and remove buttons.
  • Variation Swatches – Variation dropdowns on product pages become color, image or label swatches that work with the keyboard. Choose the swatch type per attribute in Products → Attributes, and set each color, image or label on the attribute’s terms.

Module buttons appear on the product cards of the Archive Products, Products, Related Products, Upsells and Cross-Sell blocks.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Product Comparison – Shoppers compare products side by side: price, rating, stock, attributes and more.
    • Compare Button – Adds the product to the comparison or removes it.
    • Compare Bar – A floating bar with the products to compare.
    • Compare Table – The products side by side, with a “Highlight differences” switch.
  • Variation Swatches Extras – Crossed-out unavailable options and swatches in Quick View.
  • Wishlist Extras – WooCommerce wishlist integration and wishlist support for cached pages.
  • Module Buttons on WooCommerce Grids – Quick View, Wishlist and Compare buttons on WooCommerce’s own product grids.

Starter Templates

Start a new template from a ready-made design, then change anything in the block editor.

Single Product

  • Single Page – Gallery beside the product details, with tabs and related products below.
  • Stock Progress Bar (Pro) – Large gallery with a buy box that shows the stock left and the time left on a sale, plus upsells.

Shop

  • Shop – Shop title and intro above a sortable three-column product grid.
  • Shop with Filters (Pro) – Product filters in a sidebar beside the product grid; the grid updates without a page reload.
  • Shop with Categories (Pro) – Centered intro and category list, then a four-column product grid.
  • Shop Flip (Pro) – Four-column grid whose cards show the second gallery image on hover, with a grid/list switch.

Product Archive

  • Archive – Category title and description above a sortable product grid.
  • Category with Sidebar – A category list in a sidebar next to the product grid.
  • Category with Filters (Pro) – Product filters in a sidebar beside the category’s products.

Cart

  • Standard Cart – Cart items, totals and cross-sells, with a page heading.
  • Cart with Trust Badges – Fast shipping, secure payment and easy returns notes above the cart.

Empty Cart

  • Best Sellers – Empty cart message and shop button beside your best-selling products.
  • New in Store – A friendly empty cart message, a shop button and the newest products.

Checkout

  • Standard Checkout – Contact, shipping and payment steps beside the order summary.
  • Checkout with Reassurance – A secure-checkout message above a one-column form, with help notes below it.

Quick View

  • Side by Side – Product image next to the price, short description and add to cart.
  • Compact Card – A centered card: image on top, then title, price and add to cart.

Order Received

  • Thank You Note – A short, centered thank-you with the order summary and a keep-shopping button.
  • Order Confirmation (Pro) – Order status, summary, totals, downloads and addresses.

My Account

  • Classic Account – Account navigation beside the account …
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Noah Shop Builder for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”
  6. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated

After Activation

  1. You’ll see a “Build Shop” link in the plugin actions
  2. Navigate to any page/post editor
  3. Start adding Noah Shop Builder blocks from the block inserter
  4. Customize your blocks using the settings panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Noah Shop Builder for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. The plugin will show an admin notice if WooCommerce is not detected.

Is Noah a Gutenberg WooCommerce builder?

Yes. Noah is a Woo builder made for Gutenberg. Every shop, product, cart, checkout, thank-you and account page is built from WooCommerce blocks in the WordPress block editor.

Is Noah a free Woo shop builder?

Yes. The Woo shop builder, all 50 Woo blocks, the starter templates and the Quick View, Wishlist and Variation Swatches modules are free. Pro is an optional add-on.

Can I build a Woo store with Gutenberg blocks only?

Yes. Noah’s Gutenberg Woo blocks cover the shop, product, cart, checkout, thank-you and My Account pages, so your whole Woo store is built in the block editor.

Do I need Elementor to build my Woo store?

No. Noah works in the WordPress block editor, so you can build a complete Woo store without Elementor or any other page builder.

What Woo blocks are included?

50 WooCommerce blocks for single product, shop and archive, cart, checkout, thank-you, My Account and wishlist pages. See the block lists above.

Can I build a custom WooCommerce shop page?

Yes. Create a Shop or Product Archive template in Noah Shop Builder → Templates, then design it with the Archive Products, Order By Filter, Archive Pagination and other shop blocks.

Does it include Variation Swatches and Quick View?

Yes. Variation Swatches, Quick View and Wishlist are free modules. Turn each one on in Noah Shop Builder → Modules.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes. Templates work with block themes (such as Twenty Twenty-Five) and classic themes (such as Hello Elementor). On a block theme the template goes inside the theme’s own template, so your header and footer stay; on a classic theme it is printed between the theme’s header and footer.

Can I use this with the Classic Editor?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for the Gutenberg block editor. You need to use the block editor to access the features.

Which payment methods work with a Checkout template?

The Checkout template is tested with WooCommerce’s built-in payment methods: Cash on delivery, Direct bank transfer and Check payments. Payment plugins that add their own scripts or redirects (for example Stripe or PayPal Payments) are not tested with it yet; if one doesn’t work, turn the Checkout template off and WooCommerce’s checkout page is used again.

Does the checkout page need to use the Checkout block or the shortcode?

Either. When a Checkout template is active, it replaces the content of WooCommerce’s checkout page. The order received and order payment pages stay WooCommerce’s own.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No coding knowledge is required. The plugin provides a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface for building your store.

Can I design the thank-you and My Account pages?

Yes. Create an Order Received template for the page shoppers see after checkout, and a My Account template for the customer account pages. Order details are shown only to the customer who placed the order.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Nothing is removed unless you ask for it, and deactivating the plugin never removes data. To remove everything when you delete the plugin on the Plugins screen, first turn on “Delete all data when the plugin is deleted” in Noah Shop Builder → Settings. Templates, settings, swatch settings and saved wishlists are then removed for good.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, Noah Shop Builder for WooCommerce is completely free, with 50 blocks, starter templates and the Quick View, Wishlist and Variation Swatches modules.

What does the Pro add-on offer?

Noah Shop Builder Pro adds Product Filters, Advanced Search, Side Cart, Free Shipping Bar, Sticky Add to Cart, Buy Now, Deal Countdown, Size Chart, Product Comparison, extra product card layouts, more My Account blocks, template export/import and more. See the “Noah Shop Builder Pro” section above, or compare plans on the pricing page.

Where can I get support?

You can find documentation and video tutorials through the plugin’s links, or reach out through the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • New: The Blocks and Modules pages show the blocks and modules of Noah Shop Builder Pro as locked cards with an upgrade link. They show as usual once Pro is active.
  • Improved: Block cards on the Blocks page link to each block’s documentation.
  • Improved: The readme lists the Pro blocks, modules and starter designs under each section.

2.1.0

  • New: Order Received (thank you) templates, with the Thank You Message, Order Overview and Order Details blocks and the “Thank You Note” starter design. Order details are shown only to the customer who placed the order.
  • New: My Account templates, with the Account Navigation and Account Content blocks and the “Classic Account” starter design. Account pages added by other plugins keep working.
  • New: Variation Swatches module. Show variation options on product pages as color, image or label swatches, set per attribute and term. Swatches work with the keyboard like radio buttons.
  • New: Settings page in the Noah Shop Builder dashboard, with an option to delete all plugin data when the plugin is deleted (off by default).
  • Improved: Accessibility. Sale badges have enough contrast (they now use your theme’s colors; override them with the –noah-sale-badge-bg and –noah-sale-badge-color CSS variables), struck-out prices are easier to read, the Cart Table coupon field shows keyboard focus, the My Account menu marks the current page with a bar and bold text, and breadcrumbs wrap on small screens.
  • Improved: Related Products, Upsells, Cross-Sell and Products blocks load their card images together instead of one by one.
  • Fix: The checkout coupon and login forms no longer show open for a moment while the page loads.
  • Fix: In the block editor, the Product Reviews block and the Reviews tab of Product Tabs show WooCommerce’s review form instead of a plain comment form.
  • Dev: New filters let add-ons add product card layouts and displays, Product Tabs and Account Navigation layouts, product archive URL parameters, starter design folders and Templates screen actions.
  • Changed: The “Shop with Categories”, “Account with Help Box” and “Order Confirmation” starter designs moved to the Noah Shop Builder Pro add-on. Templates you already made from them keep working.

2.0.0

  • New: Checkout templates. Design the checkout page with the new Checkout blocks: Checkout Form, Billing, Shipping, Checkout Shipping Methods, Additional, Order Notes, Order Review, Checkout Payment, Checkout Coupon and Checkout Login.
  • New: Starter designs Standard Checkout and Checkout with Reassurance.
  • New: Modules page in the Noah Shop Builder dashboard. Turn modules on and off and change their settings.
  • New: Quick View module. A “Quick view” button on product cards opens the product in an accessible popup with gallery, variations and add to cart. Design the popup with a Quick View template (starters: Side by Side, Compact Card).
  • New: Wishlist module, with the Wishlist Button, Wishlist Counter and Wishlist Table blocks. Works for guests and logged-in customers, includes privacy export and erase.
  • New: Product cards show sale and out-of-stock badges (can be turned off per block).
  • Improved: Product card images have width and height set and the first row loads right away, so pages don’t jump while they load.
  • Improved: Dashboard pages are in setup order (Welcome, Blocks, Modules, Templates), and the Welcome page covers checkout, Quick View and modules.
  • Fix: The dashboard’s tab highlight could sit off the current tab until the first click.
  • Dev: Card action slots let modules and other plugins add buttons to product cards (noah_shop_builder/card_actions).
  • Changed: The Stock Progress Bar, Products Per Page Filter and Archive View Mode blocks, the overlay and flip card layouts, the accordion and stacked Product Tabs layouts, module buttons on WooCommerce’s own product grids, and the “Stock Progress Bar” and “Shop Flip” starter designs moved to the Noah Shop Builder Pro add-on. Without it, templates that use them keep working: those blocks are hidden, cards use the standard layout and Product Tabs use tabs.

1.3.0

  • New: Shop templates. Design Single Product, Shop, Product Archive (categories, tags and search), Cart and Empty Cart pages in the block editor and choose where each template shows (all pages of its type, or chosen products and categories).
  • New: Starter designs for every template type, plus a live preview with a real product.
  • New: Shop & Archive blocks: Archive Products (standard, list, overlay and flip card layouts), Products, Archive Title, Archive Description, Archive Result Count, Archive Pagination, Order By Filter, Products Per Page Filter and Archive View Mode.
  • New: Cart blocks: Cart Table, Cart Total, Cross-Sell, Empty Cart Message and Return To Shop.
  • New: Templates page in the Noah Shop Builder dashboard to create, preview and manage templates.
  • Improved: Welcome page with a getting started guide, and a Modules page listing upcoming modules (Quick View, Wishlist, Product Comparison, Variation Swatches).

1.1.0

  • New: Store Notices block.
  • New single product blocks: Product Image, Excerpt, Description, Meta, SKU, Stock, Categories, Tags, Rating, Reviews, Share, Tabs, Additional Information, Add To Cart, Breadcrumbs, Related Products, Upsells and Stock Progress Bar.
  • Improved: Product Title and Product Price work anywhere a product is known (loops, single product templates, any page with a chosen product); price, SKU, stock, weight and dimensions follow the selected variation.
  • New: Blocks are grouped into Noah categories in the inserter (Single Product, Shop & Archive, Cart, Checkout, My Account, Modules).
  • Improved: Block toggles in Noah Shop Builder → Blocks save automatically.
  • Improved: All block editor code loads as one script; disabled blocks no longer appear in the inserter.
  • Fix: The Product Price block no longer overwrites the global product.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Product Title Block
  • Product Price Block

  • Product Filters – Lets shoppers narrow the products without a page reload, with product counts and a shareable URL. Holds the filter blocks below.
    • Category Filter – Pick one or more product categories.
    • Price Filter – Set a price range with a slider or by typing it.
    • Attribute Filter – Filter by an attribute such as color or size, as a list, swatches or a dropdown.
    • Rating Filter – Show only products rated at least a number of stars.
    • Stock Status Filter – Show only products in stock, on backorder or out of stock.
    • Active Filters – The filters the shopper picked, each with a remove button.
    • Reset Filters – A button that turns every filter off.
  • Products Per Page – Lets shoppers choose how many products the page shows.
  • Archive View Mode – Grid and list buttons that switch the product view without reloading.
  • Advanced Search – A product search box that lists matching products while the shopper types, with an optional category menu.
  • Product Category List – Your product categories with images and product counts, as a grid, a list or a carousel.
  • Recently Viewed – The products a shopper looked at earlier in their visit.
  • Deal Products – Products on sale with an end date, soonest first, each with a countdown.
  • Flash Sale Products – Products whose sale falls inside the campaign dates, with a countdown to the end.
  • Product Card Layouts – Overlay and flip card layouts, a carousel display for product lists and swatches on cards.

Cart Blocks

  • Cart Table – Cart items with quantities, remove links, the coupon field and the update button.
  • Cart Total – Cart totals with shipping, taxes, the shipping calculator and the checkout button.
  • Cross-Sell – Cross-sell products for the items in the cart.
  • Empty Cart Message – The “Your cart is currently empty.” message for the empty cart page.
  • Return To Shop – A button that takes shoppers back to the shop page.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Side Cart – A cart icon with the item count that opens a cart drawer: change quantities, remove items and go to checkout without leaving the page.
  • Free Shipping Bar – “Add $12 more to get free shipping!” with a progress bar, for the cart, product pages and headers.

Checkout Blocks

  • Checkout Form – The checkout form. The billing, shipping, order review and payment blocks go inside it.
  • Billing – The billing address fields, and the create account fields for guests.
  • Shipping – The “Ship to a different address?” toggle and the shipping address fields.
  • Checkout Shipping Methods – The shipping method choice, shown apart from the order review.
  • Additional – Extra order fields added by WooCommerce or by plugins such as Checkout Field Editor.
  • Order Notes – The order notes field, saved as the customer note on the order.
  • Order Review – The “Your order” table with products, shipping, taxes and total, updated as the shopper fills in the form.
  • Checkout Payment – The payment methods, terms checkbox and Place order button.
  • Checkout Coupon – The “Have a coupon?” link and coupon form.
  • Checkout Login – The “Returning customer?” link and login form for guests.

Thank You Blocks

  • Thank You Message – The thank-you message of the order received page, or the failed payment message with its Pay button.
  • Order Overview – The order number, date, email, total and payment method.
  • Order Details – The ordered items, totals and downloads, with the payment method’s instructions and the addresses.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Customer Details – The billing and shipping addresses, shown to the customer who placed the order.
  • Payment Instructions – What the payment method shows after checkout, such as bank transfer details.

My Account Blocks

  • Account Navigation – The account menu: dashboard, orders, addresses, account details and more.
  • Account Content – The account page being visited, including pages added by other plugins.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Login / Register – The login form and, when your store allows it, the registration form.
  • Account Dashboard – The welcome text and links to the other account pages.
  • Account Orders – The customer’s orders, with pagination.
  • Account Downloads – The customer’s downloadable products.
  • Account Addresses – The billing and shipping addresses and the form to edit them.
  • Account Details – The form for the customer’s name, email and password.
  • Horizontal Account Navigation – A horizontal layout for the Account Navigation block.

Modules

Turn modules on in Noah Shop Builder → Modules. Each one is off until you turn it on, and has its own settings.

  • Quick View – A “Quick view” button on product cards opens the product in an accessible popup, with gallery, variations and add to cart. Design the popup with a Quick View template.
  • Wishlist – Shoppers save products from product cards and product pages. Works for logged-in customers and guests; a guest’s list moves to their account when they log in.
    • Wishlist Button – Adds the product to the wishlist or removes it.
    • Wishlist Counter – A heart with the number of saved products, linked to the wishlist page.
    • Wishlist Table – The saved products with price, stock, add to cart and remove buttons.
  • Variation Swatches – Variation dropdowns on product pages become color, image or label swatches that work with the keyboard. Choose the swatch type per attribute in Products → Attributes, and set each color, image or label on the attribute’s terms.

Module buttons appear on the product cards of the Archive Products, Products, Related Products, Upsells and Cross-Sell blocks.

Pro (Upgrade)

  • Product Comparison – Shoppers compare products side by side: price, rating, stock, attributes and more.
    • Compare Button – Adds the product to the comparison or removes it.
    • Compare Bar – A floating bar with the products to compare.
    • Compare Table – The products side by side, with a “Highlight differences” switch.
  • Variation Swatches Extras – Crossed-out unavailable options and swatches in Quick View.
  • Wishlist Extras – WooCommerce wishlist integration and wishlist support for cached pages.
  • Module Buttons on WooCommerce Grids – Quick View, Wishlist and Compare buttons on WooCommerce’s own product grids.

Starter Templates

Start a new template from a ready-made design, then change anything in the block editor.

Single Product

  • Single Page – Gallery beside the product details, with tabs and related products below.
  • Stock Progress Bar (Pro) – Large gallery with a buy box that shows the stock left and the time left on a sale, plus upsells.

Shop

  • Shop – Shop title and intro above a sortable three-column product grid.
  • Shop with Filters (Pro) – Product filters in a sidebar beside the product grid; the grid updates without a page reload.
  • Shop with Categories (Pro) – Centered intro and category list, then a four-column product grid.
  • Shop Flip (Pro) – Four-column grid whose cards show the second gallery image on hover, with a grid/list switch.

Product Archive

  • Archive – Category title and description above a sortable product grid.
  • Category with Sidebar – A category list in a sidebar next to the product grid.
  • Category with Filters (Pro) – Product filters in a sidebar beside the category’s products.

Cart

  • Standard Cart – Cart items, totals and cross-sells, with a page heading.
  • Cart with Trust Badges – Fast shipping, secure payment and easy returns notes above the cart.

Empty Cart

  • Best Sellers – Empty cart message and shop button beside your best-selling products.
  • New in Store – A friendly empty cart message, a shop button and the newest products.

Checkout

  • Standard Checkout – Contact, shipping and payment steps beside the order summary.
  • Checkout with Reassurance – A secure-checkout message above a one-column form, with help notes below it.

Quick View

  • Side by Side – Product image next to the price, short description and add to cart.
  • Compact Card – A centered card: image on top, then title, price and add to cart.

Order Received

  • Thank You Note – A short, centered thank-you with the order summary and a keep-shopping button.
  • Order Confirmation (Pro) – Order status, summary, totals, downloads and addresses.

My Account

  • Classic Account – Account navigation beside the account …
